content:
Ivy (Design): quick sync  on a compact preview for autoscale controls. idea: inline "Preview" chip that surfaces est. cost + latency when slider or steppers focused. prototype in figma: https://figma.com/file/xxxxx/compact-preview
Marco (PM): important: show both Dedicated estimate and Hosted approximation. keep numbers small and clearly labeled.
Jess (Frontend): can show cached calc client-side. will scope keyboard shortcuts (arrow up/down for single step, shift+arrows for bigger step) only when the panel is focused.
Leo (A11y): accessibility notes: 1) preview must appear on focus as well as hover. 2) include aria-live region and visible text for sparklines. 3) ensure contrast for preview chip in dark theme.
Rory (Infra): debounce rule: group UI changes for 700ms before calling scale API. also edge: burst toggles should not create immediate hardware provisioning calls until confirmed.
Ivy (Design): microcopy candidate: "Estimated impact: +$1.20/hr (dedicated), +0.03¢/token (hosted). Latency: +25ms". open to tighter wording.
Marco (PM): prefer "Estimated impact" header. add small "Why?" link to explain estimation model.
Jess (Frontend): implementation plan: optimistic UI, rollback toast with "Retry". aria-live toast for failures. will add role="spinbutton" on steppers and suffix like "GPUs".
Leo (A11y): good. also avoid tiny font for the suffix. keep sparkline alt text like "latency median 68ms, 99th 118ms" offscreen.
Ivy (Design): mobile: hide hover affordances, surface a "Preview" button under the control that opens a compact sheet.
deploy-bot: scheduling: autoscale-compact-preview -> staging at 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC :rocket:
Marco (PM): timeline: Jess prototype this week, a11y pass next, infra to validate debounce logic. thanks!
Ivy (Design): thanks team 2b will iterate on copy and push updated figma by EOD.
